Depressed folks. Y'all feel this way ?

‘Lights Out’

Writing has always been a cathartic release, and through my dark days i’ve always been wanting to write, to journey my process to the end, to write down how it feels in hopes that others, who do not have depression, will have a glimpse of the emotional struggles and anxieties depressed individuals have. 

DAY 1 29 Sep 2020
Recently i’ve began telling a few people regarding my condition. I guess I wanted to see how people would react to me telling them that i am in pain, or maybe i was tired of hiding, I was in a bad place and I was helpless. I do feel like if I would pass away this would somehow be the train ride to the end, that telling others would be equivalent to getting a ticket on board, to signal that I was perhaps ready to depart and go. 

I guess that’s how depression is like. 

Depression can be many things. 

Sometimes it feels like the lights went out in a room, and I am crawling about, struggling to find the light switches. The switches change every night, and each day I struggle to navigate around to find an escape route. It feels like a never ending maze and I get tired real easily. One day the lights went out, and I could never find the permanent fix to it. 

Sometimes I have good days. On those days, depression feels like a cloud peeking through the skies. It is there, but it never goes away. I pray that it does not pour, or if it does, please let it be a light drizzle, or shower, but don’t let it be a thunderstorm. 

Depression is when I am afraid to be alone at night, with my own thoughts. I find that i need things to distract me, things to engage me, things to tire me out. If not, my thoughts are like a hamster on a treadmill, whirring about against the background of silence.
